title: Juicy Adventurous Cashew Nuts Paleo Stir-fry
description: A floral and juicy paleo-friendly stir-fry featuring roasted cashew nuts with a touch of adventurous Mexican flair.

ingredients.name: cashews
ingredients.notes: Make sure to soak cashew nuts for at least several hours before roasting

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: Use fresh ginger or a jar of crystallized ginger if unavailable

ingredients.name: jalapenos
ingredients.amount: 2 canned in juice, seeded and finely chopped

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Spread soaked cashew nuts evenly on a baking sheet.
Roast cashews in the preheated oven for about 25 minutes or until golden brown and crispy, stirring occasionally.
In a small skillet over medium heat, sauté ginger and jalapenos for about 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add finely chopped onions to the skillet and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until translucent. Add sliced scallion whites and continue cooking for an additional minute.
Mix roasted cashews with the sautéed onion, ginger, jalapenos, and scallions. Season with sea salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately as a snack or meal complement.
